subject: GridIron vendor benchmark: credit allocation & timeline
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@gridironhealth.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.inference>; Liam O'Reilly <liam.oreilly@gridironhealth.com>
Cc: GridIron Health - Procurement <procurement@gridironhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GridIron evaluation window — vendor comparison and credits request

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the throughput profile and the latency numbers you showed. We're running a tight vendor benchmark next month where we'll evaluate Redwood alongside two other vendors. The RFP timeline is below:

- RFP release: 2026-09-24
- Side-by-side tests (3 days): 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-01
- Evaluation complete: 2026-10-05

To make the comparisons fair, procurement asks each vendor to provide a short-term credit allocation for evaluation traffic plus a one-week trial extension for any throughput tuning we need. Can Redwood provide:

- A token credit allocation sufficient for ~150k generated tokens during the test window
- A 1-week trial extension on any trial account we use for the tests

Attached is our current RFP (GridIron_RFP_v2.pdf) — you'll see the workloads and the scoring rubric. If you can share an authorization letter or a short promo form, that will help our procurement/legal team move quickly.

Would you be able to confirm by EOD Monday (2026-09-21)? We need to lock vendor commitments to proceed.

Best,
Samira
Director, Platform Engineering
GridIron Health

[Attachment: GridIron_RFP_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

From: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@gridironhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-09-20T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GridIron evaluation window — vendor comparison and credits request

Hi Samira — really appreciate the clear timeline and the RFP. Glad the demo resonated.

We can support the benchmark and want to make sure we provide enough runway for a thorough evaluation without setting inappropriate long-term expectations. Proposed allocation:

- Token credit: 150,000 generated tokens (applies to model: redwood-2-std)
- Trial extension: 7 days for the trial environment used during the tests
- One quick onboarding session (30 min) with our solutions engineer to ensure KV cache + batching settings match your workload

I'll need quick authorization from our Deals desk for credits >100k tokens. I'm looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Monica (partner ops) to approve logistics and the promo form. If procurement can confirm a single-point contact and the DocuSign for a short promo addendum, we can finalize by Monday.

Next steps from our side:
- Marissa to approve promo credits and signoff on the allocation matrix
- Monica to issue the promo-authorization.pdf and DocuSign link
- I will run the 30-min onboarding call and schedule engineering ramp-up

Happy to chat if you want to go over scoring or adjust token counts.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: proposed_allocation.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

From: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.inference>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: GridIron request — 150k eval tokens + 1wk extension (need approval)

Marissa / Rishi,

GridIron Health is running a three-way benchmark and asked for 150k generated tokens and a one-week trial extension. Pricing/impact estimate below:

- 150k gen tokens @ typical unit cost ~ (equiv $4.2k)
- One-week extension: operational (no direct charge)
- Additional SE support: 0.5 FTE-hours (covered)

I recommend we offer a 150k token allocation but cap the account-level promo exposure at a $5k equivalent value. We should require a signed promo addendum (simple one-pager) to avoid unexpected rollovers. GridIron's procurement wants confirmation by EOD Monday.

If you approve, Monica can prepare the promo-authorization.pdf and DocuSign. I'm happy to join the final call with Samira to set expectations.

Alex

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-09-22T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: GridIron request — 150k eval tokens + 1wk extension (need approval)

Thanks for the context — approve with a small modification.

Approval:
- Token credit: 120,000 generated tokens (approved) — please document as promo allocation 'GD-9823-EVAL'
- Trial extension: 2 weeks (we'll be generous given the complexity)
- Promo cap: $5,000 equivalent (hard cap)

Conditions:
- Promo addendum must be signed before credits are released (monica to own)
- No automatic renewals; credits expire 30 days after issuance

Monica: please create the promo-authorization.pdf and a DocuSign route for GridIron procurement. Alex: once it's signed, push credits and schedule the onboarding.

—Rishi
VP, Sales Operations

[Attachment: promo-authorization.pdf (PDF, 8KB)]

From: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@gridironhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.inference>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-09-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GridIron evaluation window — credit confirmation and next steps

Hi Samira — great news: we've approved a promo allocation for GridIron. Summary of what we've authorized: 

- Allocation: 120,000 generated tokens (promo code GD-9823-EVAL)
- Trial extension: 14 days (applies to any trial environment used for the benchmark)
- Cap: $5,000 equivalent; credits expire 30 days after issuance

Attached is the one-page promo addendum we need signed. Once it's back, Monica will issue the credits and I'll schedule a 30-min onboarding with your SE lead.

Action items:
- GridIron procurement to sign the attached promo addendum (DocuSign link below)
- Alex to run onboarding once DocuSign completes
- GridIron to share test account details and one point of contact for the 3-day run

DocuSign (sample): https://app.docusign.com/samples/GD-9823-promo (will be the actual link in the outbound)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/GD-9823

Thanks — looking forward to a clean, apples-to-apples benchmark.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
